direct_official_checks: OS Terrain 50 is supplied as grid and contour data
both data types are supplied as 10km-by-10km tiles
tiles are identified by the National Grid reference of the south-west corner
the grid has regular 50m post spacing
grid and contour products are supplied separately
candidate OS corroboration records the selected tile identifier
wrong-tile or ambiguous-tile lookup blocks corroboration acceptance
quality_effect: Makes OS Terrain50 corroboration deterministic at the tile-selection stage.
